subject.title: fix(google): support GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID for Vertex AI

question: Should OpenClaw accept `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` as a Google Vertex project alias across auth evidence and runtime resolution?
rationale: This is a useful compatibility fix with live proof, but env/config surfaces are high-bar and the upstream `@google/genai` Node env path only reads `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT`, so maintainer intent should confirm the OpenClaw-specific alias.

options.title: Accept the additive alias
options.body: Land the PR after normal exact-head merge gates, treating `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` as an OpenClaw-supported Vertex project alias.

options.title: Ask for provider-owner narrowing
options.body: Hold the PR if provider owners want docs wording, a different precedence order, or a narrower auth-evidence-only change before expanding runtime recognition.

options.title: Do not add the alias
options.body: Close or request removal if maintainers want Vertex to stay aligned with the upstream SDK env names only.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive alias
recommendation.body: Land the PR after normal exact-head merge gates, treating `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` as an OpenClaw-supported Vertex project alias.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent Google Vertex ADC reliability work and maintainer-authored provider changes make this the best available owner for the env-surface decision.
